messages:
marta: FYI: Security is rolling out a change to service token TTLs and SCIM group sync cadence. This affects CI/CD runner tokens and any long-lived service accounts. Read below for impact and required actions.

josh: What exactly is changing?

marta: TL;DR: Default service token TTL reduced from 365d -> 30d for tokens with admin or wide scope. Non-admin tokens default TTL -> 90d. SCIM sync frequency will move from hourly -> every 15m for group membership (to reduce stale access delays).

pekka: Why the sudden tightening?

marta: Recent review showed several service tokens mis-scoped + one token created in 2022 still active. Shortening TTL reduces exposure window; more frequent SCIM sync fixes delays when oncall or role changes happen.

josh: Timeline? Any freeze window?

marta: Rollout plan:
- 2026-12-20 00:00 UTC: New defaults enforced for any newly created tokens.
- 2026-12-27 00:00 UTC: Backfill policy run to flag existing tokens exceeding new TTLs and create rotation tickets.
- 2027-01-03 00:00 UTC: Auto-expiration enforced for tokens not rotated or exempted.

pekka: How do teams detect affected tokens?

marta: Use `rwdnctl tokens list --format csv --fields id,owner,created_at,scopes,role` then filter by created_at older than 30d/90d depending on scope. Example: 
```
rwdnctl tokens list --format csv --fields id,owner,created_at,scopes | grep admin | awk -F, '$3 < "2026-11-20"'
```
(we'll publish a helper script in #eng-security pinned).

josh: What about CI runners with embedded tokens? Breaking change risk?

marta: Action items for infra/ci teams:
1) Replace embedded tokens in runners with short-lived tokens via OIDC (recommended).
2) For now, mark any tokens used by runners in the ticketing form to request a staggered migration window (max 14 days).
3) Update terraform modules to use `rwdn_oidc_provider` resource and avoid static tokens.

sec-bot: Automated scan (2026-12-15 09:12 UTC): 12 tokens identified with admin scope and age > 180d. Created tickets: SEC-7012, SEC-7013, SEC-7014.

pekka: Exceptions? We'll need a couple for legacy on-prem connectors that can't do OIDC yet.

marta: Exceptions allowed but must include compensating controls: IP allowlist, narrow scopes, monitoring alert. Submit via the #eng-security exception form and include tech contact and end date. Exceptions reviewed by Security + Infra.

idp-bot: SCIM sync change scheduled at 2026-12-18 02:00 UTC. Expected impact: 15m resolution for group membership, short burst of SCIM calls. Rate limits accounted for.

josh: Will there be an export of tokens flagged during backfill?

marta: Yes, backfill will attach a CSV to each created ticket. Teams should attach rotation confirmation (new token id) to the ticket.

pekka: Acknowledged. I'll start hunting runner configs and open tickets for our services.

marta: Thanks. We'll post a reminder 48h and 24h before enforcement and host an office hour: 2026-12-19 16:00 UTC in #eng-security.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-12-18 00:00 UTC.
